scope: Fuse ReadRAF address-weight condensation into the existing RAF histogram pass. The public scanner API, transcript, record order, field formulas, cache formulas, output layout, and cycle phase remain unchanged.
ownership: Keep the existing single records, weights, cache values, cache-valid flags, partial scratch, and output owners. There is no state clone or extra trace-sized allocation.

Stable-partition the existing job vector once during layout. Store the RAF partition boundary, not duplicate job vectors. Job descriptors and previous-challenge storage remain alive through the existing single batch completion.
correctness: Canonical RAF intervals partition every representative exactly once. Only RAF jobs multiply and write weights, including cached representatives.
Every RAF batch completes before cache construction or suffix readers. Cache construction remains once per phase, including the case with no suffix jobs.
The first histogram-combine batch clears the whole output; later RAF and suffix batches add. Partial scratch is fully written and consumed before reuse.
The existing cached predicate is metadata-only. The cache update continues to scale valid entries by previous[0], while newly eligible caches read the now-condensed representative weights.
Phase zero performs no condensation. Progress advances once after successful GPU completion and owned output construction. Errors propagate.
resources: The existing three-lane histogram uses 15,360 bytes of threadgroup memory, or 30,720 bytes with validation instrumentation. This change does not add scratch or alter reflected admission.

evidence.kind: Same-source, alternating-order paired diagnostic across all 16 address phases. Every authoritative state element and output matched; the proof and both verifiers passed.
evidence.interpretation: This is component evidence. No production whole-proof speedup has been measured for this extraction. Production removes the diagnostic clone, comparison, baseline execution, and unused condense entry.

validation: Run the existing compact_read_raf_matches_reference_through_device_handoff oracle normally and with Metal validation. It covers range-cache phases, a tail-only block, odd prefix, cycle handoff, and the independent reference backend.
Run relevant parallel and serial kernel Clippy and integrated prover Clippy. No new fixture or test family is needed.

Combine the production release measurement with other accepted changes only when root schedules it; attribute any whole-proof change to the combined revision. Require 16 completed metal_read_raf_address_phase spans with algorithm=fused_condense, exact frozen inputs/output/cycles, and no diagnostic spans.
